description: Deletes one collection from Development, with its records — the dashboard's own delete, at once, with no approval (Development is what this connection builds). Never Live: a collection Live has stays in Live, and a promote never removes anything from Live — removing Live's is its own request (request_live_action delete_collection), approved by the founder in their browser. declare_collection makes it again, empty. On the founder's Logs.
name: dev_delete_collection
title: Development: delete a collection
